summary: A request has been received by the City Clerk's Office related to the 7th Annual Reggae Xclusive event at 1677 Wilson Avenue West on July 7, 2018.
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Directed that the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario be advised that the Etobicoke York Community Council is not in support of the following event, and is opposed for liquor licensing purposes: - 7th Annual Reggae Xclusive event at 1677 Wilson Avenue West on July 7, 2018.
